verdict.rationale: Vestd's own docs describe digital cap table management as a single reconciled source of truth, covering share issuance, share classes, EMI/option grants, valuations, and Companies House sync — directly matching the core story. However, evidence lacks explicit mention of SAFE/convertible instrument tracking or explicit auditor-facing features, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing copy. Missing for 10: SAFE instrument support evidence, auditor-specific usage confirmation, independent/third-party validation of 'single source of truth' claim.
